LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Poetry 1.2.1 Introduction - Distinguish poetry from prose - Sources of poetry - .

   D. Copy random text without understanding Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fiction - Categories of non-fiction.

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
